# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.12

*Version code 70*

## What's New

**Favourite Add-ons and Plugin Collections**
Favourite an Add-on or plugin collection directly from Settings to keep it at the top of its list.
When StreamDek searches for streams, enabled favourites are now tried before other enabled Add-ons
and collections. Favouriting never turns a disabled source on or starts playback automatically, and
the provider's original stream labels remain untouched unless StreamDek formatting is enabled.

**A choice of Normal or Minimal player controls**
The player now offers two focused layouts. **Normal** keeps the familiar full controls, while
**Minimal** uses a cleaner, lower-profile dock designed around icon-only playback. The retired
Compact option automatically falls back to Normal for anyone who previously selected it.

**More reliable peer-to-peer playback**
The on-device peer engine and its local streaming path have been rebuilt for more dependable magnet
and torrent startup. The launch screen now explains connection and buffering progress more clearly,
and Settings includes a storage control for the peer cache.

## Improvements

**A more polished player**
Videos now begin in Full screen scale without stretching. The Normal progress bar is centred and
shorter, its bottom menu takes up less vertical space, and the Minimal layout has its own slimmer
timeline and menu treatment. Playback buttons are lighter and better balanced, with a softer play
icon and large invisible touch targets retained for seeking and tapping.

Brightness and volume feedback now appears in the middle of the screen instead of underneath the
finger performing the gesture. The Sources drawer has also been simplified: per-stream favourites
have been removed and Download is positioned consistently at the centre of the source card's right
edge.

**Player controls that adapt to you**
New controls cover double-tap seeking, double-tap play and pause, control labels, title display and
fullscreen status-bar behaviour. Long-pressing an icon still identifies it when labels are hidden,
and locking the player prevents accidental gesture and playback input without hiding the way back
in.

**Home density and card presentation**
Choose how much content Home fits on screen with previews that show the result before it is applied.
Card spacing and proportions now follow one layout system across Home rows, Continue Watching and
other browsing surfaces, while rating badges can be controlled consistently across supported cards.

**Settings are easier to navigate across StreamDek**
Mobile Settings now follows the same familiar journey used by TV and the Web Control Center:
Account & Profiles, Appearance, Playback, Sources, Connections and About. Platform-only controls
remain on the device they affect, and reorganising the pages does not change whether a preference is
stored for the account, the active profile or this phone.

**Clearer Live TV presentation**
LIVE and VOD badges use a smaller treatment that leaves more of the channel visible, while existing
channel gestures, favourites and progress controls continue to behave as before.

## Fixed

* Fixed movies with stray provider season or episode metadata appearing in Continue Watching as if
  they were series episodes.
* Fixed player gesture indicators being obscured by the finger changing brightness or volume.
* Fixed the Sources drawer retaining the discontinued per-stream favourite action.
* Fixed source-card text competing with the Download action for space.
* Fixed previously saved Compact player-layout values continuing to open a hidden layout.
* Fixed several peer sessions failing during startup or losing access to their local streaming
  socket before playback was ready.
